sentences.text:
Criminal Application (Apl) No.1582 Of 2025
 (Wasim s/o. Akhtar Jimari Vs. State of Maharashtra, through Pso, Ps C
 Chandrapur and another)
 ______________________________________________________________________
 Office Notes, Office Memoramda of Coram,
 appearances, Court's orders of directions Court's or Judge's
 and Registrar's Orders.
 Mr. S.A. Mohta, Advocate for applicant.
Mrs. Sneha Dhote, App for respondent No.1.

Coram : Urmila Joshi-Phalke And
 Nandesh S. Deshpande, Jj.
1.  Vide order dated 17.10.2025 we had permitted service to respondent No.2 by all modes of service.

However, the respondent No.2 is a Food Safety Officer and the A.P.P. can accept the notice for his behalf.
2.
In that view of the matter, the office objections stands waived.
3. Mrs. Sneha Dhote, learned A.P.P. waives notice for the respondent Nos.1 and 2.
4. Learned A.P.P. submits, on instructions, that the supplementary charge-sheet in the matter is filed on 13th November, 2025.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant seeks some time to verify and whether to raise a challenge to the charge-sheet as far as present applicant is concerned.
6. In that view of the matter, place the matter for further consideration on 27th February, 2026.
(Nandesh S. Deshpande, J.) (Urmila Joshi-Phalke, J.) Wadode Signed by: Mr. Devendra Wadode Designation: PS To Honourable Judge Date: 19/12/2025 17:55:22
